Welcome to **ANTH418: Anthropological Statistics**.

This course develops practical statistical thinking for archaeology and anthropology through real research datasets, R, RStudio, and Quarto.

::: {.callout-note title="Course workflow"}
**inspect and prepare → describe → visualize → analyze → visualize the result → interpret**
:::
